title: Anker was released at the Hi-Fi Liberty 4 Pro headset with the screen in the case
text:
Anker innovated announced the production of the Liberty 4 Pro Hi-Fi highway with a case in the case in the Russian market. This is stated in the press release received by Gazet.ru.
One of the main features of the model is the sensory screen, integrated in the case of compact charging, helping to simplify the control of equipment parameters. According to the manufacturer, the Astria creative co -audio architecture (ACAA) combines with a 10.5 mm dynamic drivers and a 4.6 mm high frequency drivers with titanium coating to ensure the balance and purity of the sound. An additional digital crossover contributes to the accurate audio signal and the built function of the spatial sound that creates the effect of completely immersing when watching movies and in games.
The model of noise reduction in the model includes 6 audio costumes and 1 pressure sensor operating in adaptive mode to surrounding conditions. External noise tests are done every 0.3 seconds and automatically adjust the noise inhibition effectively, including 178%, increasing audio filtration during air tourism.
To facilitate Liberty 4 Pro users, they are equipped with six microphones with whom, allowing you to conduct clear conversations even in noisy conditions. The function of multi -point connection ensures smooth conversion between devices and fast charging technology provided 4 hours after only 5 minutes of power. The headset works up to 10 hours without recharging, and the case lasts up to 40 hours.
In addition, the protection of moisture -proof calls according to IPX5 standards. The headphones are shown in five colors and supplied in Russia for 14.9 thousand rubles.
